        📜 Terms of ServiceEnacted 25 Oct 2026

        These Terms of Use (the “Terms”) set the conditions for using NEXUS Space Edition (the “Tool”). By using the Tool, you are deemed to agree to these Terms.

        Article 1 (Services)

        This tool offers search, bookmarks, clock, weather, memos, Todo, calendar, translation, music / BGM, drawing and games on one screen. Features may be added, changed or ended without notice.

        Article 2 (Scope)

        This tool is for personal non-commercial use only. The weather data provider offers it free for non-commercial use only, so commercial use is not allowed.

        Article 3 (Prohibited)

        1. Acts violating laws or public order
        2. Infringing others’ copyright, privacy or other rights
        3. Unauthorized redistribution or sale of this tool, or publishing modified versions (unless permitted by the creator)
        4. Acts that overload external services (weather API etc.) or violate each service’s terms
        5. Acts of impersonation, unauthorized access or other interference with the tool or external services

        Copyright of this tool’s program, screen design and text belongs to the GitHub account ‘[kinokokenatto]’ owns the copyright.

        Article 4 (Data)

        1. Memos, Todo, events, settings and drawings are saved only in your browser’s local storage. This tool itself does not send them to the creator’s or third-party servers.
        2. Saved data is not encrypted. Do not store passwords or card numbers on shared devices.
        3. Data may be lost by clearing browsing data, resetting the device or lack of storage. Please back up the data you need yourself.
        4. Weather info communicates directly from your browser to an external service (Open-Meteo) when auto-fetch is allowed in settings or when you press Refresh. Your IP address and browser info reach the destination. Auto-fetch can be stopped in privacy settings.
        5. Translation processes your text on the device if your browser has built-in translation (language data may download the first time). Pressing the Google, DeepL or Bing buttons sends your text to those sites. Do not enter secrets such as passwords.

        Article 5 (External services)

        External sites and services opened from this tool (Google, Microsoft, search engines, news sites, etc.) belong to each provider. Their content, terms and handling of personal data follow each provider’s rules. There is no partnership, sponsorship or endorsement between this tool and these companies.

        Article 6 (Accuracy)

        Weather and news are for reference only, without guarantee of accuracy.

        Article 7 (Disclaimer)

        This tool is provided as is, with no guarantee of operation, safety or fitness for a purpose. To the extent permitted by law, the creator is not liable for damage (including data loss) from using or being unable to use this tool.

        Article 8 (Changes)

        These terms may be changed as needed. Changed terms take effect when posted on this tool.

        Article 9 (Governing law)

        These terms are governed by Japanese law.

        🖥️ Device info

        🌐 Recommended browsers
        • Recommended: Google Chrome Microsoft Edge (both latest). Operation is mainly verified on these two (Chromium).
        • Available: Safari (iPhone, iPad, Mac) and latest Firefox. Display and some features may differ.
        • Unsupported: Internet Explorer

          For a comfortable experience

          • JavaScript and enable site data storage (localStorage). In private mode, saved data may disappear when closed.
          • Weather needs external communication. It cannot show if communication is restricted by in-app previews, company / school networks or browser extensions. In that case, download the file and open it directly in a browser.
          • Built-in browser translation works in supported browsers (mainly latest Chrome). In unsupported browsers, use the buttons that open external translation sites.
          • Always keep your browser up to date.

            💻 NEXUS CodeBridge

            Local code conversion assistant ＋ NEXUS Assistant+ Language Design Lab

            Supported: Python / JavaScript / Java / Go / R / TypeScript / C / C# / C++ / Cython / Rust / PHP / HTML / BASIC. Input code is processed on the device and not sent by this app. The local converter mainly converts basic variables, output and comments. It does not fully auto-convert complex syntax, libraries or type / memory model differences, so check the converted code’s behavior.

            ✦ NEXUS Assistant+ High-accuracy conversion request

            Creates a prompt for complex code. Code and prompts are never sent externally automatically. Copy only when needed and paste manually into a trusted AI service.

            Write code freely and save it in the chosen language. AI assist creates a generate / fix prompt and opens the selected external AI. Code is not sent automatically. Paste the AI reply on the right, check it, then apply it to the editor. Not every language can run in the browser.

            A mode for designing your own programming language. From your settings, it generates a language spec, grammar, sample code, a Python transpiler draft and a detailed prompt for external AI, all locally. No built-in AI API is used. Output is a prototype and needs tests and implementation to become a practical language.

            🔒 Entered code / language designs are never sent.Conversion is not guaranteed complete. Check code before running.

            🧑‍💻 NEXUS HTML Source editor

            For admins: You can load and edit the whole current NEXUS HTML or a selected HTML file. Edits are not run on this screen. After inspection, export as a new HTML file and reopen it if needed. The original open file cannot be overwritten directly with browser permissions.

            Press Load current NEXUS source to edit the current HTML snapshot. Up to 5 MiB.

            On export, the existing CSP meta tag is detected and the SHA-256 hash of the inline script is recalculated. A warning is shown if an external file without CSP is opened. Scripts in the HTML are not run in this editor.
